lesson.title: From Model Outputs to Business Recommendations
lesson.description: In this session, students learn how to translate the outputs of their Monte Carlo simulator into actionable business recommendations that a partner can understand and act upon. The lesson addresses one of the hardest transitions in data-driven decision-making, moving from a distribution of possible outcomes to a single defensible course of action. Students will examine the "flaw of averages" and why point estimates mislead executives, explore the six requirements of Decision Quality (appropriate frame, creative alternatives, relevant and reliable information, clear values and trade-offs, sound reasoning, and commitment to action), and practice articulating recommendations that explicitly acknowledge uncertainty, trade-offs, and confidence intervals.
